title: YoTeAyudo
tagline: An app to help gig workers secure affordable loans through community support, utilizing the Celo Minipay wallet.
description: A collective loan platform to help gig workers on latin america based on mini pay. The idea is to connect your gig worker account instead of a credit score so other users can give help you with a loan. Most of the gig workers in latam does not have access to credit scores. So other people can give you the loan based on your performance.
how_its_made: By using mini pay, we can create a wallet super simple to our users, then they need to connect their gig worker account, then an attestation so they claim their profile with that info they can ask for a loan and users can fill that loan. Everything is done easy because our users do not need to create a wallet.
